provenance: DOI and license of each dataset, read on checkedOn from PSI's own investigation record (https://psi.nasa.gov/geode-py/ws/repo/investigations/<accession>, the service the PSI page calls) and from the DataCite record of the DOI (https://api.datacite.org/dois/<doi>). Both sources agree. Earlier that day the PSI service answered HTTP 500 and only DataCite could be read.

PSI-10.reason: No license is declared: the license fields of PSI's own record (licenseName, licenseIdentifier, licenseLink) are empty and the DataCite record of the DOI has an empty rightsList. The team rule is that no dataset is used without a verified license, so the test tables of this investigation are not in this project.
